resources.string: Delete only unbound enrollment credentials. Existing profile credentials, profiles, routing, and diagnostics are preserved. Pending enrollment requests will need to be created again.

Existing storage must be verified before connections can resume. Confirming starts a local protected-storage migration. Inconsistent or interrupted state remains blocked; no automatic repair or reset is performed. Existing records are preserved for recovery.
A previously confirmed presentation update could not be durably completed. You may explicitly ask the protected-state broker to verify and finish only that update.

Protected profiles or credentials are quarantined because their consistency cannot be proven. Connections remain blocked. Review privacy-safe diagnostics, then choose a separately confirmed reset or deletion only if needed.

Protected storage is inconsistent or unavailable. The app will not repair, initialize, delete, or recreate keys automatically. Connections remain blocked until an explicit supported recovery or reset succeeds.

Cleanup of a sensitive preview or native resource could not be proven. Reuse and connection activation remain blocked. Review privacy-safe diagnostics; restarting or resetting is never performed silently.

The durability or final state of a protected mutation could not be proven. The previous known-good state is preserved where possible, no new authority is activated, and an explicit recovery decision is required.
